How we work together.

A short path from audit to a shop that grows on its own momentum.

  1. Step 1

    Audit

    I go through your shop, products, creators and ads and mark what is leaking sales.

  2. Step 2

    Fix the base

    Listings, pricing, samples and commission get tightened before any money goes into scaling.

  3. Step 3

    Launch creators and ads

    Affiliate outreach and GMV Max start together, so each feeds the other.

  4. Step 4

    Scale what sells

    Budget moves to winning products and creators. Weekly numbers, no guesswork.
